_comment: NSE symbol -> moneycontrol sc_id. See References/fundamental-criteria.md
§ Known Provider Limits: moneycontrol addresses companies by its own id
and publishes no working endpoint to derive one from a ticker, so this
mapping is maintained by hand and a symbol absent from it is reported as
Every entry below was verified by fetching the pricefeed and checking the
NSEID it returned. Do that before adding one: sc_ids are not mnemonic and
the wrong guess resolves to a real but different company. 'HU' looks like
Hindustan Unilever and is Unimers India.
Tools/fundamentals.py re-checks NSEID on every fetch, so a bad entry here
fails loudly instead of contributing another company's ratios.
